column3: The speech is addressed to Ithiel, repeated twice, and Ukal; the Hebrew words are not phrased as I am weary, O God.
The comparison is more brutish than a man rather than an explicit superlative most ignorant.
The final clause says and knowledge of the holy I know, without repeating a negative directly before that verb. The holy is plural in form.
The cloak lacks an expressed His.
God’s word is refined or tested, the image underlying flawless.
Close to the Hebrew.
Asking is expressed as completed.
A word of falsehood is singular.
The denial lacks an explicit You, and the final action literally takes hold of God’s name.
Close to the Hebrew.
The generation’s father and mother are singular.
The final noun explicitly names its excrement.
Its eyelids are lifted up rather than glances being described as pretentious.
Close to the Hebrew.
The final failure to say enough is expressed as completed.
The land’s lack of satisfaction and fire’s not saying enough are expressed as completed.
Plucking out and eating are future verbs rather than an explicit may wish.
I have not known them is a completed negative, rather than an explicit inability to understand.
The ship is in the heart of the sea.
Eating, wiping, and saying are expressed as completed actions.
The earth’s trembling is expressed as having occurred.
The fool is satisfied with bread specifically.
The woman is hated rather than simply unloved.
Wise and made wise repeat the wisdom root, rather than a separate word exceedingly.
The ants are called a people, and preparation is expressed as completed.
The rock badgers are called a people; their home is singular and its placing is completed.
The locust is collective singular, and its going out is expressed as completed.
You grasp the lizard with hands, rather than it being a passive object that can be caught; the king is singular.
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
